what_changed: Reflection form now enforces evidence meaning when 1~2 curated evidence items are selected; empty selection is the explicit Skip path.
Replay payload moved to strict helper-based filtering: 7-day window + 3-tier meta types + deterministic cap.
Universe/Replay close CTA wording was normalized to 'Close Replay' with Skip retained, plus Streamlit fallback controls.
Tier counts are surfaced in replay caption for demo-time proof of T1/T2/T3 hierarchy behavior.

validation.name: plan_focus_journal_routing_check
validation.command: rg -n 'Plan Start|Focus Now' app.py && rg -n 'elif m == "desk"|elif m == "chronos"|elif m == "control"' app.py

validation.name: reflection_curation_guard_check
validation.command: rg -n 'Evidence Curation|max_selections=2|증거 선택을 해제해 Skip|meta_type="supporting_evidence"' app.py

validation.name: replay_7day_3tier_ui_check
validation.command: rg -n '_build_weekly_replay_payload|7-Day Read-Only Replay|Close Replay \(UI Fallback\)|Skip Replay \(UI Fallback\)' app.py && rg -n 'Tier 1: Completed|Tier 2: Interrupted|Tier 3: Evidence|Close Replay|REPLAY_SKIP' universe_3d.py
